title: NF-YA isoforms with alternative splicing of exon-5 in Aves.
authors: Gallo, A; Dolfini, D; Bernardini, A; Gnesutta, N; Mantovani, R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鸟类NF-YA转录因子剪接异构体及其TAD结构，并用AlphaFold预测蛋白结构，虽涉及TF-DNA互作体系但未聚焦结合机制，方法仅结构预测，属广义TF相关但深度不足。
abstract: NF-YA, the regulatory subunit of the trimeric CCAAT-binding transcription factor NF-Y, is present in vertebrates in two major alternative spliced isoforms: NF-YAl and NF-YAs, differing for the presence of exon-3. NF-YAx, a third isoform without exon-3/-5, was reported only in human neuronal cells and tumors. These events affect the Trans-Activation Domain. We provide here evidence for the expression of NF-YAx and for the existence of a new isoform, NF-YAg, skipping only exon-5. These isoforms are abundant in Aves, but not in reptiles, and are the prevalent transcripts in the initial phases of embryo development in chicken. Finally, we analyzed NF-YAg and NF-YAx amino acid sequence using AlphaFold: absence of exon-5 denotes a global reduction of beta-stranded elements, while removal of the disordered exon-3 sequence has limited effects on TAD architecture. These data identify an expanded program of NF-YA isoforms within the TAD in Aves, implying a role during early development.
abstract_zh: NF-YA是三聚体CCAAT结合转录因子NF-Y的调控亚基，在脊椎动物中以两种主要的选择性剪接异构体存在：NF-YAl和NF-YAs，二者的区别在于外显子-3的存在与否。NF-YAx，一种缺少外显子-3/-5的第三种异构体，仅在人神经元细胞和肿瘤中被报道。这些事件影响反式激活域（Trans-Activation Domain）。我们在此提供证据表明NF-YAx的表达，以及一种仅跳过外显子-5的新异构体NF-YAg的存在。这些异构体在鸟类中丰富，但在爬行动物中不丰富，并且是鸡胚胎发育初期的主要转录本。最后，我们使用AlphaFold分析了NF-YAg和NF-YAx的氨基酸序列：外显子-5的缺失表明β-折叠元素整体减少，而去除无序的外显子-3序列对TAD结构的影响有限。这些数据揭示了鸟类TAD内NF-YA异构体的扩展程序，暗示其在早期发育中的作用。
